owner_authorization: October 6 owner explicitly extends job-count authority and requests Marrakesh and Quebec comparisons. Original approximately120-second cumulative QPU allowance remains.
information_policy: Same fixed development inputs/targets/circuits as local pipeline diagnostic. No new hyperparameters, final-test reads, backend-performance search or model promotion.
execution_policy: Two single-job Sampler executions, no active session billing. Freeze and validate before submission; exclusive per-arm submission intent before API call. No automatic retry of an existing or ambiguous submission. Cancellation/failure usage counts toward allowance; no replacement jobs.
layout_policy: Deterministic connected ten-qubit path from backend coupling graph; first four encode QSVR. Verify measured physical mapping across overlap circuits; calibrate actual measured qubits for selector separately. Fixed layout/transpiler seed.
analysis_policy: Preserve actual hardware counts and circuits. Compare raw/combined suppression at matched forward shots; fit fixed QSVR and ridge, reuse paired calibration to compute independent-qubit readout reconstruction, PSD and fixed rank-four train-derived repair. Report downstream hectares/fire, kernel geometry, feasible fraction/SQD gap and actual usage. Two executions are not replicated calibration blocks. Combined arm cannot attribute hardware benefit to DD versus twirling.
measurement_policy: Measurement twirling is Runtime-managed. Readout calibration estimates each arm's effective independent assignment channel; no claim of exact removal of correlated/readout-frame-specific effects.
preflight_revision: Before plan freeze/submission, local installed Sampler inspection showed a single program shot count; all 73 PUBs therefore use 512 shots, including calibration. Earlier timing preflight used mixed counts and was not submitted.
budget_policy: Fez completed at25 charged seconds; four added single jobs capped23 seconds each reserve92 more, cumulative worst-case117. No sessions, replacement submissions or ambiguous retries.
comparison_policy: Same parent data, circuit families,512 shots/PUB, fixed regressors, four development years and suppression settings as Fez. Deterministic device-native layout/compilation differs; publish depths, native gates and physical mapping. One raw/combined pair per device is descriptive, not replicated calibration or proof one computer is intrinsically better. Quebec uses PINQ account and Marrakesh personal account; queue/account context differs.
